description: krtffl org baseline. Every repo extends exactly this, or one of the tier presets that extends it.
Validated against renovate-schema.json x-renovate-version 44.11.8.
Ecosystem behaviour lives in the six manager fragments extended below; this file only holds
cross-cutting policy: cadence, commit style, grouping, rate limits, and the security fast lane.
prBodyNotes: Raised by Renovate from `github>krtffl/renovate-config`. Change policy there, not here.

description: Fast lane. Renovate documents that vulnerabilityAlerts PRs ignore branchConcurrentLimit,
commitHourlyLimit, prConcurrentLimit, prHourlyLimit and schedule, so these PRs jump the
Monday-only queue on their own. minimumReleaseAge is nulled so the 3-day quarantine that
applies to routine updates does not delay a fix. Requires GitHub Dependabot alerts to be ON
for the repo and the Renovate app to hold read access to Dependabot alerts.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive pins on the first Monday of the month, outside the normal update flow.

packageRules.description: Majors never join a group and never move on the 3-day quarantine — they get a week and their own PR.

description: Security fixes that need a MAJOR bump get a human in the loop, without losing the fast lane.
The obvious mechanism — dependencyDashboardApproval — cannot be used here, and the reason is
worth writing down because the config reads as if it should work. Renovate turns every alert
into a synthetic packageRule (vulnerabilityToPackageRules) appended to the END of
packageRules, carrying the whole vulnerabilityAlerts object in that rule's `force` key, and
mergeChildConfig ends with `{ ...config, ...config.force }` — so force is re-stamped after
every later merge. dependencyDashboardApproval:false is one of Renovate's OWN built-in
vulnerabilityAlerts defaults, so it sits in force even when this file never mentions it, and
no packageRule at any level can flip it. That is why the :manual tier's majors-wait rule
applied its `major` label to the astro v7 security PR while its dependencyDashboardApproval
silently did not take effect.
draftPR, reviewers and addLabels are NOT vulnerabilityAlerts keys, so force does not carry
them and they survive. The PR is still raised immediately — this gates the MERGE, not the
creation, which is deliberate: a CVE should never sit invisible behind a checkbox.
MAINTENANCE HAZARD: isVulnerabilityAlert is an internal Renovate field. It does not appear
in renovate-schema.json, and this rule only matches on the second applyPackageRules pass
(the synthetic alert rule that sets the flag is appended after this one, and the rules array
is snapshotted per pass). renovate-config-validator therefore CANNOT detect it silently
breaking. Re-test on every Renovate major upgrade. Verified against renovate 44.29.5:
major+security -> draftPR true; patch/minor+security -> unchanged, prCreation immediate and
minimumReleaseAge null; major non-security -> unchanged, dependencyDashboardApproval true.
The documented alternative, $exists(vulnerabilityFixVersion), only fires on the GitHub
Dependabot path and would miss the osvVulnerabilityAlerts source this config also enables.

packageRules.description: 0.x minors are breaking under semver — treat them like majors: ungrouped, own PR.
Vendored, generated and fixture trees are not dependencies of this repo.
